trade.title: Trade
trade.editHint: Choose item quantities and currency, then save your offer. Empty nonempty containers before trading them.
trade.unsaved: Unsaved changes. Save your offer before confirming.
trade.intro: Exchange items, pay with currency, or give a gift. Assets move only after both participants confirm.
trade.noTargets: No other players' characters are available online.
trade.invitation: A trade is open. Open the Trade tab in your character's inventory.
trade.recoverWarning: Both inventories and currency balances will be restored from their pre-trade snapshot. Later changes to those assets will be lost. Ensure nobody is editing either actor and the previous GM is no longer executing the trade. Continue?

errors.coordinator: The trade coordinator disconnected or changed. Ask the active GM to inspect the trade state.
errors.provider: Could not read currencies or the active Item Piles API. Check its configuration.
errors.providerChanged: Currency providers or definitions changed or differ between participants. Cancel and start a new trade.
errors.amount: Enter a valid nonnegative currency amount.
errors.funds: Insufficient funds or an invalid coin quantity.
errors.item: An item is missing, duplicated, contains other items, or has insufficient quantity.
errors.stale: The offer changed or this trade is closed. Review the current state.
errors.changed: An offered item changed. Save the offer and confirm again.
errors.transfer: The trade operation failed. Check the trade state and GM log.
errors.noGM: An active GM is required to safely transfer assets between characters.
errors.permission: A participant is unavailable or does not own this actor.
errors.partner: Select an available character belonging to another online player.
errors.busy: This character is already trading or awaiting recovery.
errors.empty: Offer at least one item or some currency.
errors.timeout: The GM did not respond in time. Check the trade state before trying again.
errors.rolledBack: The transfer failed. Inventories and currencies were restored to their pre-trade state.
errors.recovery: The transfer was interrupted. A GM must inspect the saved snapshot and restore the trade. Further trading is blocked.
